references.text: In the first census in the wilderness, the tribe of Manasseh was counted as 32,200 men. This shows the development in the size of the tribe compared to the count in Numbers 2:23.
In the second census on the plains of Moab, the tribe of Manasseh was counted as 52,700 men, showing significant growth from the number in Numbers 2:23.
Jacob's blessing over Ephraim and Manasseh, where he prophesied that both would become great peoples. Numbers 2:23 shows the fulfillment of this blessing for the part of Manasseh.
Manasseh was Joseph's firstborn son, born in Egypt. His descendants made up the tribe that was counted in Numbers 2:23.
